title: International Higher National Diploma in Information Technology (Level 5)
description: The International Higher National Diploma in Information Technology (Level 5) equips students with the skills to excel in the fast-paced, ever-evolving world of technology.
university: The Global School of Skills (GSS) and African University
longDescription: The purpose of the International Higher National Diploma in Information Technology (Level 5) is to develop students professionally and personally, equipping them with the skills to meet the demands of the rapidly evolving IT sector. This course enhances your ability to understand technological issues, analyze IT challenges, and find effective solutions. It introduces essential concepts that are crucial for understanding how IT systems and businesses operate, ensuring that whether you pursue higher education or enter the tech industry, you will stand out with a critically developed understanding of the key skills needed to excel in the digital world. This International Higher National Diploma in Information Technology (Level 5) serves as a strong foundation for further education in IT and opens up diverse employment opportunities in the tech industry. After the successful completion of the Programme, you will earn a UK 240 credit hours Certification awarded by GSS partners.
courseDetails: Each module consists of 40 guided learning hours of material with an additional 30-50 hours worth of optional materials which comprise of recommended exercises, recommended readings and internet resources. Within the modules are self-testing exercises. You must take care in answering these. Although they are not marked nor do they count towards your final assessment, the marking is tested against your scoring on the final assessment to check for consistency of score. Successful completion of the full Level 5 Diploma in information technology will give students the right credentials to go on and apply for a job in marketing, accounting, human resources, management or business consultancy.

entry: For entry into Level 5 International Higher National Diploma in information technology, learners must possess:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.
Mature Learners (21 years and older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership, or management roles. (This is assessed on a case by case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: University Top-up On completion of this course, students have the opportunity to complete a Master degree programme from our Partner University. The top-up programme can be studied online or on campus. The top-up comprises the final 60 credits which consist of either a dissertation or a dissertation and one module. (The course tuition fee listed above does NOT include the top-up fee) University Progression Click here to see University routes and fee information for progression.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.
